# Process manual

This manual describes inbound receiving at the north sites.

# Receiving

Pallets are checked against the ASN {++within two hours ++}on arrival{-- at the dock--}.

Late trucks are logged by the shift lead.[^1]

- Unload the trailer.
- Scan every pallet label.
1. Check the seal number.
2. Record exceptions in the log.
